content.title: GSK Digs In On Allergies With $2.2 Billion Rapt Therapeutics Buyout
content.summary: GSK is buying Rapt Therapeutics for $2.2 billion, the companies said Tuesday.  Rapt is working on an IgE antibody blocker called ozureprubart to prevent allergic reactions to food allergens.  Rapt estimates around 94% of severe food allergies are caused by IgE-mediated reactions.
